title: Sandbox balance assertions race with gas refunds when using max_gas()
summary: Prepaid gas from `.max_gas()` is refunded asynchronously, so a balance read right after a transaction can be off by up to about 1 NEAR and the refund lands later.

steps: Attach explicit gas (about 60 Tgas) instead of `.max_gas()`.
Allow a small gas tolerance in balance assertions.

evidence.observed: Reproduced 2026-11-13 (macOS 15 arm64, rustc 1.100.0, cargo-near 0.23.0, near-sdk 5.30.1, node 26.12.1): with max_gas the borrower balance delta read 11.0007 NEAR instead of 10 NEAR right after the transaction; explicit 60 Tgas plus fast_forward(5) gave stable results.
